project_type: Python FastAPI backend + TypeScript Cloudflare Edge Worker + React frontend monorepo
build_system: pip-compile for backend, wrangler for edge, vite for frontend
verification_instructions: Run pytest on the backend tests. Specifically test_auth.py and any new test files for anon access.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Python 3.11 available via pyenv. No MongoDB/Redis in test environment - tests mock these.
contribution_requirements: Tests use httpx AsyncClient with ASGI transport. Rate limiting is mocked in conftest.py. Beanie (MongoDB ODM) is mocked for unit tests.
key_patterns: Auth dependencies: get_current_user (required auth, raises 401), get_current_user_optional (returns None for anonymous). Edge worker has PUBLIC_PATHS (no JWT check), OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATHS (JWT validated if present, anonymous allowed if absent). Anonymous users identified by x-anon-id header (format: anon_<32 hex chars>). Chat saved with user_id=anon_id for anonymous users.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - route handlers; apps/backend/app/api/deps/ - shared dependencies (rate limiting); apps/backend/app/core/ - security, rate limiter; apps/backend/app/models/ - Beanie MongoDB models; apps/edge/src/middleware/ - edge JWT/CORS/rate-limit; apps/frontend/src/context/ - AuthContext; apps/frontend/src/utils/ - API client
